description-research: "Collin Brice, Ph.D., CCC-SLP is a speech-language pathologist and Assistant Professor at the University of Scranton. His research focuses on speech-gender perception and incorporating mixed methods research methods into speech and voice research. He is also interested in using and refining alternative grading methods in CSD courses."
description-os: "He was originally drawn to open science as a means to achieving more equity and accessibility within science. As he steps into his own research, he has found open science practices to be a way to increase the rigor of his own work, find more collaborators, and circumvent some of the barriers keeping research out of the hands of the general public."
